However, standard RAG encodes each passage in isolation, so it struggles with tasks that need knowledge integrated across passages.","citationIds":["c1"]},{"text":"RAG addresses the information gap caused by an LLM's reliance on pretraining data by sourcing and incorporating knowledge from external databases.","citationIds":["c2"]},{"text":"A survey organizes retrieval optimization into indexing, query, and embedding optimization, followed by post-retrieval processing and LLM fine-tuning in generation.","citationIds":["c2"]},{"text":"Pre-retrieval work improves the index (data granularity, index structure, metadata, alignment, mixed retrieval) and the query (rewriting, transformation, expansion).","citationIds":["c3"]},{"text":"Post-retrieval work includes reranking chunks and compressing context, with reranking placing the most relevant content at the edges of the prompt.","citationIds":["c3"]},{"text":"Hybrid retrieval strategies integrate keyword, semantic, and vector searches to serve diverse queries.","citationIds":["c4"]},{"text":"HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings) decomposes dense retrieval into a generative task done by an instruction-following language model and a document-document similarity task done by a contrastive encoder. It works without relevance labels and handles varied query types without changing the underlying models.","citationIds":["c5"]},{"text":"Modular RAG moves beyond a fixed retrieve-then-generate pipeline, for example through iterative flows such as ITER-RETGEN's Retrieve-Read-Retrieve-Read and frameworks such as Demonstrate-Search-Predict.","citationIds":["c4"]},{"text":"Adaptive retrieval methods such as FLARE and Self-RAG let LLMs decide when and what to retrieve, evaluating whether retrieval is needed in a given scenario.","citationIds":["c6","c4"]},{"text":"Hierarchical retrieval uses a structured index, for instance summarizing document sections before a secondary retrieval within the document. Multi-hop retrieval instead digs into graph-structured sources to extract interconnected information.","citationIds":["c6"]},{"text":"GraphRAG extends retrieval to graph data.
